note: All runs: weight-only, per-channel asymmetric, adaLN W8 RTN, BoA layer-output (GPTQ) path, damping = fork default (1%), act_order off, 32 calibration images x 2 branches x 50 steps, B = 10 buckets. `uniform` = p = 1/B over per-bucket Grams with the CFG branch weights s^2/(s-1)^2 folded in (the handoff's H_t); `uniform, plain pooled` = equal branch weights too (what LLM-style quantizers and Q-DiT do). Gain = fp32 median-of-ratios (configs/gain_choice.json).
